title: The Pledge Beyond Jordan
reflectionText: Sheepfolds and fortified towns stood on one side of the Jordan, while a shared battle waited on the other. Reuben and Gad changed their request into a public pledge, and Moses bound the gift to their word. What is it to carry responsibility alongside a desired inheritance?
editorialNotes: Packet 016 writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling keeps Moses’ recalled Kadesh warning distinct from the present request, revised pledge, and conditional agreement in Numbers 32:1-27.
